name: Classynt Schools
author: classynt

sections.description:
Classynt Schools gives a school everything it needs to run results, staff and students day-to-day — without spreadsheets or a paid SIS.

School setup

  • School name, motto, address, contact details and logo
  • Report accent colour and head teacher sign-off (signature image or name/date)
  • Configurable per-term assessment components (e.g. CA1/CA2/Exam, or CA/Exam) and grading scale, with ready-made presets
  • Sessions, terms, classes, sections and subjects

Student management

  • Add and manage students, with automatic PIN generation for portal login
  • Per-class sections

Student result portal

  • Public shortcode: [classynt_result_portal]
  • Students sign in with an admission number and a four-digit PIN
  • Printable, print-optimised termly report card matching a standard school report layout: subject scores, attendance, psychomotor/affective ratings, class/head teacher comments, and more
  • Classic report card template

Results workspace

  • Session, term and class filters, with AJAX-loaded rosters

Staff/teacher portal

  • Staff sign in with a Staff ID and PIN — no WordPress user account required
  • Teachers only see the classes, sections and subjects assigned to them
  • Enter and save results directly from the teacher dashboard
  • Admin-controlled staff and assignment management, including per-section access restriction

Coming soon

  • Assignments — teachers post work, students submit it from their own dashboard
  • Announcements — school-wide or class-specific notices on the student/teacher dashboard
  • Practice exams — timed, computer-based simulations for standardized tests

Pro

Classynt Pro adds:

  • Promotion from one class/session to the next, with an optional pass-mark condition
  • Per-session fee gate — mark a student’s session Paid or Outstanding, with the public portal blocking Outstanding results until settled, plus bulk fee-status controls per class
  • Additional report card templates: Academic, Comprehensive, Progress, Competency and Transcript
  • Result locking per session/term/class
  • Audit trail of result changes
  • Additional staff-management capabilities, including student add/edit and class promotion from the teacher dashboard

Additional Pro functionality is not included in this WordPress.org build.

External services

This plugin uses Freemius, a licensing and software-update platform, to manage optional license activation for the Pro version and (only if you choose to opt in) anonymous usage analytics that help us improve the plugin.

No data is sent to Freemius automatically when the plugin is activated. On first activation you’re shown a one-time opt-in screen with two options — “Skip” or “Allow & Continue” — and nothing is transmitted to Freemius until you make that choice. If you click “Skip”, no usage data is shared and the plugin works fully. If you click “Allow & Continue”, or if you later connect a license or account from the Account page, the following is sent: your site URL, WordPress and PHP version, this plugin’s version, and (for connecting an account) the name and email of the WordPress user connecting it. No student, teacher, parent, or school data stored by this plugin (results, attendance, admission numbers, PINs, etc.) is ever sent to Freemius or any other third party — all of that stays in your own WordPress database.

This service is provided by Freemius Inc.
Terms of Service: https://freemius.com/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://freemius.com/privacy/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/classynt-schools, or install directly through the WordPress plugin screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to School Results → Settings and enter your school’s details.
  4. Create a session (e.g. 2025/2026) and its terms.
  5. Create classes and subjects, and assign subjects to classes.
  6. Add students — a login PIN is generated automatically.
  7. Place [classynt_result_portal] on any page, or let the plugin create one for you automatically.
sections.faq:
Do I need a separate account system for students?

No. Students authenticate with their admission number and PIN — there is no WordPress user account behind a student.

Can teachers log in without a WordPress user account?

Yes. Staff sign in with a Staff ID and PIN issued by the administrator, and only see the classes and subjects assigned to them.

How do I stop a student from seeing a result before school fees are paid?

This is a Classynt Pro feature. On Classynt Pro, mark that student’s session status as “Outstanding” from the Results screen and the public portal blocks the report until an administrator marks it “Paid.”
sections.changelog:
1.9.13

  • Fixed: result printing now fits on one page (desktop and mobile) and no longer shows the loading animation.
  • Students and Teachers: notices explain that a PIN is shown once and can be reset.
  • Teachers: fixed Ctrl/Cmd selection of multiple sections; clearer class, section and subject instructions.
  • Classes: clearer explanation of sections.
  • Staff Portal: all class subjects are listed, but scores can only be entered for the subjects assigned to the teacher.
  • Settings: cleaner layout — no overflowing boxes or empty gaps, Save button aligned right.

1.9.12

  • Fixed printing a result on mobile so the whole result fits on one page, including when the paper size is changed in the print dialog.
  • Student Portal now shows “Result not available for this term.” when no scores are entered for the selected term.
  • Added a show/hide icon to the PIN field on the login pages.
  • Fixed missing stylesheets and scripts in the released package (admin and portal screens appeared unstyled).
  • Teachers screen: subjects are now chosen per class from that class’s own subjects, with a “Select all subjects” option.

1.9.11

  • WordPress.org review follow-up and compliance fixes, including the verified Freemius external-services disclosure and an upstream Freemius SDK debug-page fix.
